rationale:
Issue #511 reports that BaseRequest forwards the caller-supplied method verb to the request stream unvalidated, enabling CRLF/header injection, and states the expected behavior explicitly ('an exception should be thrown for methods outside the known set'). The pre-existing defect is visible in the buggy constructor `BaseRequest(this.method, this.url)`, which performs no token check. The production fix in lib/src/base_request.dart adds `_tokenRE`/`_validateMethod` and routes the constructor parameter through it, throwing ArgumentError for non-token verbs; the only other constructor edit (`this.method` -> `String method` plus `method = _validateMethod(method)`) is mechanically required to insert the check, not a refactor. The minimized production patch touches exactly one production file and excludes the CHANGELOG entry and test files present in patches/original-commit.patch, so it carries no documentation-only, configuration-only, or test-only content and no feature extension beyond the validation the issue asked for. The triggers are the unchanged upstream tests from the same fixing commit (PR #512, single commit) and exercise only the pre-existing public constructors http.Request('LLAMA[0]', ...) and http.StreamedRequest('SUPER LLAMA', ...); `_validateMethod` and `_tokenRE` are private, so no new production API is required to drive them. Both rejected verbs contain characters outside the HTTP token set ('[', ']', space) and are precisely the injection-capable inputs the reporter described. Strict evidence (original and post-minimization) reports all gates passed: build on both revisions, unique selectors, buggy differential reproduction of both triggers, deterministic fingerprints across 3 repetitions in a 38-run matrix, fixed isolated/suite/reversed runs clean, and fixed full suite green with no baseline exclusions. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/http#511 is the only allowed root cause key, so the root cause is not a duplicate. Traceability is fix_commit_to_issue with verified_fix_issue_numbers=[511].

Issue #511 reports that BaseRequest forwards the method verb to the request stream unvalidated, enabling CRLF/header injection, and states the expected behavior as an exception for invalid methods. The minimized production patch in lib/src/base_request.dart adds _tokenRE plus _validateMethod, which throws ArgumentError.value for any method containing characters outside the HTTP token set, so the defect (missing method validation), the fix, and the reported expectation line up. Traceability is direct: fix_commit_to_issue with verified_fix_issue_numbers=[511] via PR 512, a single-commit change. The minimized patch touches only lib/src/base_request.dart; the CHANGELOG entry and the two test additions present in patches/original-commit.patch are excluded, and there is no formatting or refactor noise beyond the mechanical change of `this.method` to a validated initializer. The triggers exercise pre-existing public constructors http.Request('LLAMA[0]', dummyUrl) and http.StreamedRequest('SUPER LLAMA', dummyUrl) and assert throwsArgumentError; they introduce no API added by the fix, and the space in 'SUPER LLAMA' plus the brackets in 'LLAMA[0]' are exactly the injection-capable inputs described in the issue. Strict evidence for both original and post-minimization runs reports passed=true with no failed checks: buggy differential reproduces both selectors, fixed isolated/suite/reversed runs are clean, fixed full suite is green, 38 matrix runs over 3 repetitions, deterministic fingerprints (4 groups). active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so dart-lang/http#511 is not a duplicate, and it matches allowed_root_cause_ids.
